newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Faster growth to improve job market-Costello.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Faster growth to improve job market-Costello.

text.p: Australian Treasurer Peter Costello said on Thursday economic growth was expected to accelerate in the 1997/98 financial year ending June 30 which in turn would improve the labour market.
Speaking at an economists conference, Costello said recent data showed private demand remained strong in June and he expected private sector demand to grow around 3.5 percent in the 1997/98 year.
"In 1997/98 economic growth is expected to accelerate, which should result in an improvement in the labour market while inflation should remain low," he said.
The faster growth should result from stronger growth in final private demand, combined with modest growth in public demand and a small detraction from growth from net exports, he said.
Partial indicators suggested private demand remained strong in the June quarter, he added.
